summary: Tom Wetzel is the Chief of Police for University Circle, Ohio. He has spent his career in Northeast Ohio law enforcement, with a consistent focus on community policing: the belief that a police department's core work is serving and building trust with the community it protects.

speaking.summary: In seminars, Tom draws on decades of first-hand experience in police and leadership positions, focusing on what it takes to strike the right balance as a supervisor and how to tackle the critical issues facing police departments across the country today. He's available for speaking engagements and leadership consulting with departments, organizations, and event audiences.

testimonial.quote: Chief Tom Wetzel was spot on and hit the target center mast. Amazing workshop, chock full of great information and real leadership suggestions that work. This guy is good.
